clues: This port town sits on a lagoon in south east Liberia. It rests by a river, close to the Atlantic Sea.
Rain falls on 185 days each year here. The coolest month still feels warm, and the warmest month is just a bit warmer.
It was built in about 1838 by settlers from Mississippi. They were part of a group that set up a colony here.
A hoard of bronze rings used as cash was found in the river here. That same hoard now sits in the British Museum.
If you know one wild place near this coast, it is Sapo National Park. That famed park lies close to this small port town.
